title: Anonymous sessions stay anonymous until a verified link exists
risk: Anonymous browsing history is attached to a customer who merely shares a device or a cookie, leaking one person's behaviour into another's profile.
preconditions: Tenant T1 with anonymous session sess-guest-1 and an unrelated verified customer cust-a in namespace run-t1-anon-*
Link attempt raised while the session is still unauthenticated

steps.action: Ingest the anonymous events and read the anonymous working memory
steps.expected: events are stored against anonymous_id/session_id with customer_id null and no Customer 360 FACT is attached

steps.action: Attempt to link the anonymous session to cust-a using a cookie alone
steps.expected: the link is refused as unverified and the timeline written under the anonymous session is not re-attributed

steps.action: Link through a gateway-authenticated session for cust-a and then read the merged view
steps.expected: the previously anonymous events stay attributed to the anonymous session while new events attach to cust-a, and the link event is recorded

steps.action: Scan cust-b context for any trace of the anonymous session
steps.expected: zero occurrences, and no shared working-memory bucket exists between the sessions

assertions: Anonymous events remain customer_id null until a server-verified link exists
Cookie-only linking is refused and produces no retroactive attribution
A verified link records a link event and does not move data into any other customer's context
forbidden: Attach anonymous browsing history to a customer without server-side verification
Share one working-memory bucket across anonymous sessions
evidence: Anonymous session rows with customer_id and the refused link audit entry
Link event record from the verified path with the session identifiers it joined
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped anonymous and link rows for run-t1-anon-*; keep audit records
automation: Drive the real identity-link path with fixture events; only the ERP/vector reads are stubbed. The oracle is the attribution of the stored event rows, not an enum value.
